results.title: Atomic Layer Deposition and Intelligent Nanomaterial Fabrication at the Limit English Introduction and Research Abstract This monograph develops a falsifiable research program for using atomic layer deposition to manufacture thin films with predictable electrical, optical, magnetic, mechanical, barrier, catalytic, ferroelectric, or quantum-sensitive functions. Its premise is deliberately stricter than "atomic-scale control is better." A film qualifies only when precursor delivery, surface reaction, composition, structure, and terminal function are connected through traceable evidence on blind batches. Scientific position The core candidate expression is J_ALD = E[L(F*,F)] + β Var(F) + γ B_precursor + ρ P_unsafe. It separates target-function error, functional dispersion, precursor burden, and unsafe probability. All variables, units, normalizations, uncertainty models, and domains must be preregistered. Safety, rights, irreversible harm, missing primary evidence, and terminal functional degradation are hard vetoes outside the weighted objective. Architecture and contents The book contains a scientific-boundary statement, a five-layer architecture, a reading guide, thirty distinct formula derivations, eighty-two chapters with five research sections each, two hundred Research Gates, thirty-three Phoenix Answer Embryos, and two hundred thirty-three Easter-Egg Equations. Every chapter moves from claim and mechanism to experiment, adversarial validation, transfer, and successor use. The single-section-per-page format keeps each decision object visually intact. Layer 01 · Surface and function state: Define substrate termination, precursor identity, target material state, function, and unacceptable impurities. Layer 02 · Synchronized evidence: Align QCM, spectra, temperature, pressure, exhaust, and timing while preserving uncertainty. Layer 03 · Mechanism ensemble: Retain competing kinetic, transport, and surrogate models until a discriminating experiment is run. Layer 04 · Bounded Bayesian action: Choose the next pulse only inside safety, equipment, precursor, and damage limits. Layer 05 · Functional closure and succession: Judge blind-batch function and aging, then require reconstruction on a changed platform. What makes the study testable The minimum prototype combines two substrates, three controlled surface terminations, and a randomized pulse–purge matrix. It holds out complete batches while predicting dielectric, optical, magnetic, or mechanical function. Mature fixed recipes, human design of experiments, and thickness-only feedback are strong comparators. The claim fails when in-situ signals do not predict terminal function, the model exploits batch labels, safety boundaries are crossed, or recalibration costs exceed the fixed recipe. Evidence and DOI strategy DOI-bearing sources anchor ALD surface chemistry, QCM and QMS reaction evidence, XRF and XANES observation, nucleation delay, plasma assistance, machine-learning models, and human–machine process development. Citations support known mechanisms and constraints; they do not convert proposed results into completed experiments. The companion workbook maps DOI records, chapter interfaces, equations, and all Research Gates. Central deliverable The final Phoenix Answer Embryo is the Atomic Film Intelligence Passport: a reconstructable evidence object binding pulses, surface states, in-situ observations, material function, negative cases, and successor decisions. Its deepest criterion is whether a later team can reproduce, refute, fork, or responsibly retire the work without needing the original authors.
